verdict.summary: A public connection works for any workspace immediately with no review. Review (about 5-10 business days) applies only to Marketplace listing. Installation scope cannot be changed after creation, so choose it carefully.
verdict.hands_on_effort: 30-60 min for the connection; a few hours more for a Marketplace listing
verdict.approval_wait: none for unlisted use; 5-10 business days for Marketplace listing

gates.unlocks: Create the connection and authorize your own workspace.
limits: You need Workspace owner access to create connections.

gates.unlocks: Other users can install through your OAuth flow without a Marketplace listing, subject to Notion's documented rules.

steps.title: Confirm Workspace owner access
steps.detail: Only Workspace owners can open the Connections tab and create connections. Get an owner to do this if you aren't one. Notion advises building an internal connection first when developing a public one.

steps.title: Try Composio managed auth first
steps.detail: Composio's managed Notion OAuth needs no setup and has no default scopes. Use it to test before registering your own connection.

steps.title: Open the Developer portal
steps.detail: Go to Build > Public connections and select Create new connection.

steps.title: Choose installation scope
steps.detail: Pick Any workspace if you may ever list on the Marketplace. Selected workspaces only is not eligible for listing.
gotchas: Cannot be changed later; you would have to recreate the connection.

steps.title: Fill in the creation form and redirect URI
steps.detail: Enter the connection name, development workspace, and capabilities. Paste the callback URL from your Composio auth config under OAuth Domain & URIs. It must match the one used in the token request.

values.label: Redirect URI
values.value: Composio callback URL (see the Composio callout on this page)

gotchas: No fragments, relative paths, wildcards or public IP addresses (community-reported).

steps.title: Select capabilities
steps.detail: Notion uses capabilities rather than scopes. Request only what you need, such as Read content, Update content, Insert content, comments, and user information with or without email.

steps.title: Copy credentials into Composio
steps.detail: On the connection's Configuration tab, copy the OAuth client ID and secret. Add them to a custom Notion auth config in Composio, then connect your own account.

steps.title: Complete organization details for public use
steps.detail: Community guides report the form needs company name, website, tagline, privacy policy, terms of use and support email. Have a privacy policy and terms ready, or ask an agent to draft them.

steps.title: Monitor traffic and rate limits
steps.detail: Use the Health tab in the Developer portal to see the last 24 hours of requests, failures and rate-limit warnings. Build retry and backoff handling.

steps.title: Prepare the Marketplace listing draft
steps.detail: In the Marketplace listing dashboard, draft the listing name and description, category and tags, listing images and logo, and attach the Any-workspace public connection. An agent can draft the text.

steps.title: Submit the listing
steps.detail: Submit from Listings > Connections. Expect an email within 5-10 business days.

steps.title: Wait for review and fix any rejection
steps.detail: Notion reviews every submission, including security. If rejected, the email gives the reason, so fix it and resubmit.

requirements.detail: Needed to access the Connections tab and create connections.
Required for Marketplace eligibility and set only at creation.

requirements.item: Privacy policy, terms, tagline, support email, company info

Name, description, category, tags, images, logo, and the attached connection.

scopes.effect: Lets the connection read pages and databases; a read-only grant is possible.
Allows writes. No extra review tier is documented.
Most privacy-sensitive option. The docs do not say it triggers extra review.

blockers.cause: Unlisted public connections have default limits, which also apply per workspace.
blockers.fix: Add backoff and check the Health tab. Limits were reported as 600/min on Business/Enterprise and 180/min on other plans.

blockers.symptom: Users on Enterprise workspaces cannot install the connection
blockers.cause: Workspace owners can restrict which connections members install.
blockers.fix: Ask the workspace owner to approve the connection.

blockers.symptom: Cannot list a Selected-workspaces connection on the Marketplace
blockers.cause: Installation scope is fixed at creation.
blockers.fix: Create a new connection with scope Any workspace.

blockers.cause: Brand or trademark issues, quality concerns, or baseline criteria not met.
blockers.fix: Read the rejection email, fix the issues and resubmit.

composio.note: Composio offers managed OAuth for Notion with no default scopes, because Notion uses capabilities. Start on managed auth to test. You need your own public connection only for your own client ID/secret, branding, a non-Composio redirect URI, or a Marketplace listing. Confirm the Composio redirect URI (backend.composio.dev) before relying on it.
